technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present potential mean-reversion setup, but absence of bullish confirmation signals, price below all key moving averages, and bearish MACD make this a low-probability entry with significant downside risk.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 42 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-like 11 score) with bearish AAII sentiment (58%) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and stale (most recent sale 149 days ago), offering no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4) with flat yield curve, FOMC event just passed, and utilities sector facing credit stress headwinds create highly unfavourable macro conditions despite 42-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 and 14) with supertrend bullish signal and contrarian fear-zone sentiment create potential mean-reversion setup near support at 49.66.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, bearish MACD with negative histogram, no bullish confirmation signals, crisis-level VIX regime, high credit spreads in utilities sector, and zero smart money/insider conviction make this a low-probability setup with significant downside risk.
